claim_boundary: Human admission of a deliberately stratified bilingual signage cohort. It measures conditional identity opportunity, not natural prevalence. Admission is not OCR performance, open-world identity, portal ownership, access, navigation, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety evidence.
